config.hiresshot.title: HiResShot Config
config.hiresshot.multiplier.tooltip:
Scale factor based on window size.
Range: 2 - 64.
(Only used when 'Use Custom Resolution' is OFF)
config.hiresshot.hideGui.tooltip: Whether to hide HUD, chat, and crosshair during capture.
config.hiresshot.hidePlayer.tooltip:
Prevents the player model from rendering.
Useful to avoid self-shadows when using shaders.
config.hiresshot.warmupFrames.tooltip: Frames to render before saving (Instant/CPU mode).
config.hiresshot.realtimeDelay.tooltip:
Frames to wait in-game before saving.
Allows shaders to stabilize (Rec: 20-60).
config.hiresshot.captureMode.tooltip: Select how the screenshot is processed.
config.hiresshot.useCustomResolution.too: If enabled, overrides the multiplier with the specific Width/Height below.
config.hiresshot.cpuUpscaleLimitGpu.tool:
Only used in CPU Upscale Mode.
True: Limits GPU rendering to 16K (16384px) to save VRAM. CPU handles the rest.
False: Tries to render full size on GPU (Risky if > 16K).
